body:
🟡🧪 **Consider · tests: No test covers the new visible-only guard in CameraBubbleWindow.raise()**

The bar's `raise()` change has a test, but the bubble's equivalent change (`raise()` now does nothing while the bubble is hidden) has none. No `camera-bubble-window*.test.ts` exists in the directory, so this is a new test file. A short test that `moveTop` is skipped after `hide()` and called when visible would stop a regression back to the macOS behaviour where `moveTop()` puts a hidden window back on screen.

Added in b752d69b: `camera-bubble-window.test.ts` checks that `raise()` skips `moveTop` after `hide()` and calls it once the bubble is shown again (plus the no-window case). Same shape as the bar's test.
